mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 in high-inflation periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), rising unemployment signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC in high-unemployment regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO below 3-month moving average, or Rank IC is below 0.03 in contraction periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth < 1.5%), weak GDP growth signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 annual growth < 1.5%, or Rank IC in late-cycle regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS is rising, it signals aggressive monetary tightening in response to inflation, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and rising FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not significant (p>0.05).
